documents.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves query-relevant evidence before generation and cites source documents.
Cache-Augmented Generation preloads a bounded stable corpus for repeated context reuse without per-query retrieval.
Knowledge graph augmentation uses typed triples and explicit relationships for deterministic multi-hop traversal.
Table augmentation computes validated aggregations over structured rows and preserves row provenance.
